title: AI Enterprise Architect-4
description:
seattle, washington 98039 posted october 5th, 2026

  

##### **job type: full time**

##### **job category: it**

#### **job description**

**job role : ai enterprise architect**

**location : seattle ,wa (hybrid)**

**job type : full time permanent**

job description

must have technical/functional skills:

generative ai (gen ai), agentic ai

model selection, evaluation, interpretability: tensorflow, pytorch, hugging face, nlp, computer vision, time-series modeling.

ai strategy, architecture, and roadmap planning

python / r / typescript programming

ai frameworks (langchain, autogen, azure ai foundry, azure ai agent, crewai, langgraph, google adk)

model context protocol (mcp), agent to agent protocol

n-8-n

guardrails, ai ethics and regulations

prompt engineering: “expertise in prompt engineering, llm operations, and genai deployment best practices.”

distillation, rag, fine-tuning

multi-modal ai, llms

vector databases, embeddings

genai deployment tools (docker, kubernetes)

ai solution assessment and optimization

etl, data pipelines, feature stores: experience with tools like airflow, dbt, mlflow, dvc, azure ml pipelines.

ci/cd for ml: automated model retraining, versioning, and monitoring.

data anonymization, privacy-by-design, secure model deployment: especially for regulated industries (gdpr, sox, hipaa).

desirable certifications: ai/ml, cloud architecture, relevant technology (e.g., gcp genai leader, aws ai practitioner, azure ai certifications)

  
  

roles & responsibilities:

regional ai technical lead is a strategic technical leader responsible for designing, implementing, and managing advanced generative ai solutions across google cloud platform (gcp), microsoft azure, and amazon web services (aws). this role combines deep expertise in generative ai technologies, multi-cloud architecture, and modern software engineering practices to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative ai solutions. the architect leads cross-functional teams, drives technical vision, and ensures alignment between business objectives and ai initiatives.

ø strategy & roadmap

* define and drive the ai strategy, aligning with business goals and innovation priorities.

* develop and maintain the ai solution roadmap, including short-term deliverables and long-term vision.

* evaluate emerging ai trends and technologies to inform strategic direction.

ø architecture & design

* architect end-to-end ai solutions using gen ai, agentic ai, llms, and multi-modal ai.

* design intelligent agent systems using langchain, langgraph, model context protocol (mcp), agent to agent protocols, google ai development kit (adk), azure ai studio or aws bedrock.

* integrate large language models (llms) such as llama, gemini, gpt, and claude into enterprise systems and custom applications.

* establish scalable and modular ai architectures that support rag pipelines, vector dbs (chromadb, pinecone, faiss, weaviate, vertex ai matching engine).

* develop and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines using vector databases

* define and enforce ai governance frameworks, including responsible ai, guardrails, and compliance w ith ai ethics & regulations.

* supervise the design, fine-tuning, and optimization of generative ai models and multimodal systems (text, image, audio).

* lead python-based development for prompt orchestration, tool agents, apis, and data pipelines.

ø assessment & optimization

* conduct technical assessments of existing ai/ml systems, models, and data pipelines.

* identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for modernization or enhancement.

* recommend architectural improvements and integration strategies for legacy systems.

ø cloud platform integration & management

* architect, deploy, and monitor generative ai solutions on gcp (vertex ai, document ai, alloydb, bigquery, cloud run), azure (openai service, cognitive search, azure ml, azure functions), and aws (bedrock, sagemaker, lambda, api gateway, dynamodb).

* design and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and compliance across platforms.

* implement containerization and orchestration strategies using docker and kubernetes (gke/eks/aks) for reliable deployment.

* establish and enforce security frameworks using gcp iam, azure identity, aws iam, and related tools for secure, compliant access.

* utilize monitoring and logging solutions such as google cloud operations suite, azure monitor, and aws cloudwatch.

ø mlops, devops & governance

* automate model deployment, versioning, and monitoring using mlops/devops best practices and ci/cd pipelines.

* implement prompt optimization, context management, and model performance tuning.

* ensure adherence to data governance, privacy, pii handling, and ai ethics principles throughout the development lifecycle.

ø leadership & collaboration

* collaborate with product owners, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.

* mentor engineering teams and contribute to talent development in ai and ml domains.

* represent ai architecture in enterprise governance forums and technical councils.

##### **required skills**

performance architect

title: Associate Machine Learning Engineer
description:
at xifin, a culture of inclusivity is in our very fabric. we believe that this culture not only creates a more equitable and functional workplace, but also enhances our team members' work experiences by promoting creativity, innovation, and collaboration.

**who are we looking for?**

we are seeking a highly motivated **associate machine learning engineer** to join our innovative advance data analytics team. this is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their ml journey who is eager to apply their knowledge to real-world problems in healthcare, life sciences, and revenue cycle optimization.

the ideal candidate is passionate about machine learning, large language models (llms), generative ai (genai), and agentic ai; curious about data; and eager to contribute to the design, deployment, and optimization of production-grade ml solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

**what will you do?**

* design, develop, and evaluate machine learning models across healthcare and operational domains, with a growing focus on **llms, generative ai (genai), and agentic ai workflows**
* contribute to **genai and traditional model deployment pipelines**, supporting mlops practices including automation, monitoring, and continuous integration
* assist in **data preparation, prompt engineering, feature engineering**, and exploratory data analysis for both structured and unstructured data
* collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts to translate business needs into scalable, ai-powered solutions
* participate in **model validation, safety checks, bias detection**, documentation, and performance reviews for traditional and genai models
* stay up-to-date with advancements in ml, llm fine-tuning, open-source genai frameworks, data engineering, and cloud-native ai services

this is an onsite position at our office in san diego.

**what education and experience do you need?**

a combination of the following education and experience factors will be considered:

education & experience:

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience
* proficiency in python and familiarity with ml libraries such as scikit-learn, tensorflow, or pytorch
* solid understanding of ml fundamentals (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, overfitting, cross-validation)
* foundational knowledge of generative ai, agentic ai workflows, and llm architecture (e.g., prompt chaining, rag patterns, few-shot learning)
* exposure to technologies such as neo4j, vector databases (e.g., faiss, pinecone, weaviate), llm fine-tuning, and langchain or llm orchestration frameworks
* experience working with structured data (sql) and unstructured data (text, embeddings, graphs)
* familiarity with git, containerization tools (e.g., docker), and cloud environments (aws, azure, or gcp)
* excellent communication skills, curiosity, attention to detail, and a growth-oriented mindset

nice to have:

* internship or project experience involving production ml and llm systems
* exposure to mlops tools (e.g., mlflow, airflow, sagemaker, or azure ml)
* experience in healthcare, genomics, or billing analytics is a plus

**what’s in it for me?**

we don't just offer benefits; we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package tailored for you!

* dive into a world of cutting-edge healthcare with our comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including telehealth services. say goodbye to the hassle of prescriptions with our convenient mail-order program for 90-day maintenance medications.
* our health savings account (hsa) featuring pre-tax deductions and quarterly company contributions (hsa only) puts more money in your pockets!
* plan for your golden years with confidence through our 401k retirement plan, complete with a company match.
* fuel your ambition with our tuition assistance program, empowering you to reach new heights in your professional journey.
* finally, experience true well-being with xifin's bewell program, where we champion physical, mental, financial, and social wellness, because your success and happiness are our ultimate priorities

**why xifin?**

xifin is a healthcare information technology company that empowers healthcare organizations to navigate an increasingly complex and evolving healthcare landscape. through innovative ai-enabled technologies and services, we deliver operational efficiency, interoperability, and simplicity. the company’s revenue cycle management, clinical workflow enablement, laboratory information system, and patient engagement solutions enable organizations to achieve stronger finances, streamline operations, and develop industry-leading business strategies.

helping healthcare providers achieve financial strength empowers them to do more good for more people. that’s the power to do good.

description:

**job duties:** design, build, and maintain scalable ml infrastructure to support notification relevance, targeting, ranking, and personalization across channels (e.g. push, email, in-app notifications) for millions of users. architect and implement end-to-end ml pipelines for notifications, including data ingestion, feature computation, model training, evaluation, deployment, and online serving in production environments. collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and engineers across teams to define requirements, align on priorities, and deliver end-to-end notification solutions. lead design and implementation of experimentation frameworks (e.g. a/b testing, multi-armed bandits, or similar methods) to evaluate new notification models, ranking strategies, and targeting policies. mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, sharing best practices in machine learning engineering, distributed systems, and ml infrastructure design. **full-time telecommuting is an option.**

**requirements:** bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering (any field) or related quantitative discipline and five (5) years of experience in the job offered or related occupation.** **

title: Data Engineer
description:
description

icf is seeking a skilled data engineer to join our corporate it organization. you will design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure that powers insights and decision-making across our practices and support organizations. working at the intersection of enterprise data platforms and client-facing analytics, you will have direct impact on how our firm manages and monetizes its most asset — data.

this is a high-visibility role reporting to the enterprise data architect. you will collaborate closely with data analytics, cloud architecture, and application development teams in a fast-paced, client-driven environment.

**key responsibilities**

* design, build, and optimize scalable etl/elt pipelines that move data across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* implement and manage enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse solutions (microsoft fabric)
* write production-quality sql, python, and spark code for data transformation, enrichment, and validation
* implement and enforce data governance, lineage tracking, and cataloging standards across the organization
* ensure data quality through automated monitoring, testing frameworks, and sla adherence
* partner with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand and fulfill data requirements

languages & querying

sql (advanced) python pyspark bash/shell scala

microsoft fabric azure synapse azure data factory

apache airflow dbt databricks kafka spark

terraform docker kubernetes github actions ci/cd

* bachelor's degree
* 4+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a closely related role

**additional qualifications**

* demonstrated experience building and maintaining production data pipelines at scale
* experience working in a professional services, consulting, or enterprise it environment preferred
* advanced sql and proficiency in at least one scripting language (python strongly preferred)
* hands-on experience with a major cloud data platform (aws, azure, or gcp)
* strong understanding of data modeling concepts and frameworks — star schema, data mesh
* practical experience with workflow orchestration tools such as apache airflow or azure data factory
* familiarity with version control (git) and software development best practices

**preferred skills/experience**

* familiarity with streaming/real-time data processing (kafka, fabric event streams, or spark streaming)

* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy and quality
* effective communicator — able to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

* **reporta a:** presidente / gerente de producto
* **tipo de empleo:** tiempo completo/ presencial en arecibo, puerto rico

**responsabilidades principales**

* desarrollar y mantener interfaces de usuario web y móviles responsivas
* construir y trabajar con librerías de componentes de interfaz como tailwind y uso de frameworks modernos de frontend incluyendo pero no limitado a react, vue.js o angular

* colaborar en github mediante pull requests, revisiones de código (code review), manejo de issues y proyectos (github projects).
* familiaridad con contenedores (docker) y despliegue en la nube (aws, gcp, azure).
* implementar y ajustar modelos de lenguaje de gran escala (llms) y funcionalidades impulsadas por ia incluyendo pero no limitado a procesamiento de lenguaje natural, análisis predictivo y automatización
* integrar apis y servicios de ia de terceros, incluyendo pero no limitado a openai (gpt, assistants api), anthropic (claude, claude code), google ai (gemini, vertex ai) y servicios de ia de aws (bedrock, sagemaker, comprehend, textract, etc.).
* experiencia práctica con aplicaciones y plataformas de generación de código por ia como lovable, bolt.new, base44, v0 (vercel), replit agent o similares.
* habilidad para escribir prompts efectivos y estructurados que guíen a la ia a generar arquitecturas, componentes y lógica de negocio coherentes (prompt engineering aplicado a generación de apps).
* criterio técnico para revisar, depurar y "tomar posesión" del código generado por plataformas de generación de código por ia: identificar código frágil, mal estructurado, con vulnerabilidades de seguridad o que no escala.

* desarrollar y mantener pipelines de ia, flujos de trabajo de preprocesamiento de datos y marcos de evaluación de modelos
* trabajar con bases de datos incluyendo pero no limitado a postgresql, mysql, mongodb, redis y firebase
* desarrollar y optimizar consultas de bases de datos complejas, procedimientos almacenados y modelos de datos
* implementar estrategias de migración de datos, procedimientos de respaldo y planes de recuperación ante desastres
* garantizar la integridad, seguridad y cumplimiento de los datos con las regulaciones de protección de datos aplicables
* establecer y mantener un lenguaje de diseño consistente e identidad de marca en todos los productos
* ejecutar el ciclo de vida completo del desarrollo de producto desde la recopilación de requisitos técnicos hasta el lanzamiento e iteración post-lanzamiento, bajo la dirección estratégica del gerente de producto

* rastrear y reportar métricas de ingeniería, progreso de sprints y kpis técnicos al gerente de producto usando herramientas de gestión de proyectos incluyendo pero no limitado a clickup
* identificar proactivamente riesgos técnicos, bloqueos y oportunidades y comunicarlos al gerente de producto de manera oportuna

* experiencia demostrada construyendo y lanzando productos de software desde cero

* capacidad de resolución de problemas y pensamiento crítico

* design and build dashboards and reports to track ai system performance and business kpis
* partner with data scientists and ai engineers to define metrics for model evaluation and monitoring
* write and optimize sql queries to extract and transform data from various sources

* strong proficiency in sql and data querying/transformation
* experience with python (pandas, numpy) or r for data analysis
* experience with bi/visualization tools (tableau, power bi, looker, or similar)
* understanding of ai/ml concepts and exposure to evaluating model outputs or working alongside ml teams
* strong statistical analysis skills
* excellent communication skills — able to translate data insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* experience working with large datasets in cloud data warehouses (bigquery, snowflake, redshift)

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience evaluating generative ai/llm outputs (prompt quality, hallucination detection, response scoring)
* familiarity with gcp data tools (bigquery, looker, vertex ai)
* experience with a/b testing and experimentation frameworks
* background in data governance or data quality frameworks
* exposure to python-based ml libraries (scikit-learn) a plus

**good to have:**

title: Data Analyst / Analytics Developer
description:
position summary

we are seeking a highly analytical and technically capable data analyst / analytics developer to join our growing technology team.

this role sits at the intersection of data, technology, and business operations. the ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills combined with hands-on coding and technical capabilities. this individual will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting and analytics solutions, building data pipelines and automated processes, and transforming raw data into actionable business intelligence.

the successful candidate will work closely with the technology team and business stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop technology-driven solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and organizational performance.

this is not a traditional reporting-only data analyst position. we are looking for someone who can write code, work directly with databases, automate data processes, build analytical tools, and collaborate with software developers and tech leadership.

key responsibilitiesdata analysis & business intelligence

* analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
* translate business questions into meaningful data analyses and actionable insights.
* develop recurring and ad hoc reporting for business and technology leadership.
* create dashboards, visualizations, and analytical tools that clearly communicate key performance indicators and trends.
* establish and monitor key performance metrics.
* identify data quality issues and work with tech team and stakeholders to resolve them.
* perform root-cause analysis and investigate unexpected results or changes in business performance.
* present analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

sql & database development

* write complex sql queries to extract, transform, and analyze data.
* work directly with relational databases and data warehouses.
* develop queries, views, stored procedures, and other database objects as appropriate.
* assist with database design and optimization.
* combine data from multiple systems and sources to create comprehensive datasets.
* maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
* develop repeatable processes for data extraction and transformation.

coding & data automation

* use programming languages such as python, sql, javascript, or similar technologies to analyze and manipulate data.
* develop scripts and applications that automate repetitive data-related tasks.
* build automated data pipelines and workflows.
* replace manual excel-based processes with scalable, technology-driven solutions.
* develop tools that enable business users to access and analyze information more efficiently.
* collaborate with tech team to incorporate data functionality into applications.
* develop apis where appropriate to facilitate data exchange between systems.

data integration

* work with data from internal applications, databases, apis, and third-party platforms.
* develop processes to collect, transform, validate, and consolidate data from multiple sources.
* troubleshoot data integration and data-quality issues.
* partner with developers and technology leadership to improve the organization's overall data architecture.

process improvement & automation

* work with business teams to understand existing processes and identify opportunities for data-driven improvement.
* identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient data workflows.
* design and implement automated solutions that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability.
* analyze operational processes to determine where data and technology can create efficiencies.
* help establish standardized data processes and reporting methodologies.

technology & product collaboration

* collaborate with software engineers, tech leadership, and business stakeholders.
* participate in application development projects where data and analytics are central to the solution.
* provide data requirements and technical specifications for new applications.
* test new applications, integrations, and data functionality.
* assist in defining data structures and requirements for new technology initiatives.
* contribute to the organization's broader technology and data strategy.

ai & emerging technologies

* explore opportunities to leverage ai and machine learning to improve data analysis and business processes.
* work with approved ai tools and apis to develop data-driven applications and automation.
* assist with developing ai-enabled reporting, analytics, and workflow solutions.
* evaluate emerging data and ai technologies and make recommendations.
* ensure appropriate security and confidentiality controls are incorporated into data and ai solutions.

data security & governance

* maintain strict controls around confidential, proprietary, client, and company data.
* follow established data security, privacy, and cybersecurity policies.
* ensure appropriate access controls are applied to sensitive information.
* identify potential data security and integrity issues.
* follow data governance standards and help establish appropriate data-management practices.
* ensure analytical solutions are developed with security and confidentiality in mind.

required qualifications

* bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data development, or a related technical role.
* strong sql skills and experience working with relational databases.
* demonstrated programming experience in python, javascript, or another programming language.
* strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* experience manipulating, transforming, and analyzing large datasets.
* experience building dashboards and data visualizations.
* ability to translate business requirements into technical and analytical solutions.
* strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* excellent written and verbal communication skills.

preferred technical skills

experience with several of the following is preferred:

**programming & data**

* python
* sql
* javascript / typescript
* pandas
* numpy
* rest apis
* json
* etl / elt

**databases**

* sql server
* postgresql
* mysql
* snowflake
* databricks or similar data platforms

**analytics & visualization**

* power bi
* tableau
* looker
* excel
* data visualization libraries

**technology**

* git / github
* aws
* microsoft azure
* docker
* cloud-based data platforms
* ci/cd environments

**ai & automation**

* generative ai apis
* large language model integrations
* workflow automation
* machine learning fundamentals
* ai-assisted data analysis

candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed above. a strong foundation in sql, programming, analytics, and problem solving is more important than familiarity with a particular technology stack.

what makes this role different

this position is designed for someone who wants to go beyond traditional data reporting. the successful candidate will be expected to analyze data, write code, build solutions, and improve the systems that produce the data.

examples of potential projects include:

* automating a manually maintained management report.
* building a centralized dashboards.
* creating apis between business systems.
* developing automated quality-control processes.
* building predictive or trend-based analytics.
* creating data tools for internal users.
* developing ai-assisted analytics and reporting.
* improving the organization's data architecture and reporting infrastructure.

key performance expectations

success in this position will be measured by the individual's ability to:

* **produce accurate insights** — deliver reliable, actionable analysis that supports business decision-making.
* **automate manual work** — replace repetitive data processes with scalable automated solutions.
* **improve data quality** — identify and resolve data integrity and quality issues.
* **build technical solutions** — develop scripts, applications, dashboards, and integrations that solve real business problems.
* **improve efficiency** — use data and technology to streamline business processes.
* **collaborate effectively** — work effectively with other analysts, developers, technology leadership, and business teams.
* **innovate** — identify practical applications for ai, automation, and emerging technologies.

title: Data Engineer 4
description:
data engineer 4

do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? at capital one, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. we are seeking **data engineers** who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. in this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across capital one.

**what you’ll do:**

* collaborate with and across agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full-stack development tools and technologies
* influence a team of developers, data analysts and data scientists with deep experience in machine learning, distributed microservices, lakehouse architecture, and full-stack systems
* utilize programming languages such as python and spark, along with open-source relational and nosql databases, and cloud-based data warehousing platforms including databricks and snowflake
* share your passion for staying on top of trends in data, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal and external technology communities, and mentoring other members of the data community
* collaborate with product managers and software engineers to deliver robust cloud-first data solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of americans achieve financial empowerment
* independently design, build and deliver world-class cloud data solutions and applications with little or no support from supervisors or managers
* architect and enforce common data engineering design patterns to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability across data platforms and pipelines
* serve as an ambassador for the data engineering team, communicating technical concepts and data outcomes clearly to both internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and shared understanding
* design and build data pipelines and platforms with a focus on scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency, ensuring robust performance under increasing data volume and business demands
* implement data security standards, including encryption at rest/transit and fine-grained access control, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations

the travel data team is building an end-to-end travel platform designed to centralize product data and power premium customer experiences. you will lead key aspects of a large-scale, cross-cloud migration—unifying multi-cloud datasets into a central data lake using python, spark, and databricks. by architecting this foundational data backbone, you will directly enable real-time personalized recommendations, tailored travel offers, and intelligent user benefits. it’s an exciting opportunity for an engineer looking to solve complex, distributed system challenges while driving high-impact digital products at enterprise scale.

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, analytics, mathematics, engineering)
* at least 4 years of experience in application development (internship experience does not apply)
* at least 2 years of experience in distributed data
* at least 2 years of experience with sql
* at least 2 years of experience with one programming language (python, java, or scala)
* at least 2 years of experience in data pipeline design and development
* at least 1 year of experience in data modeling and designing end-to-end data solutions using both relational and non-relational database systems

**preferred qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in application development with demonstrated proficiency in python, sql, scala, or java
* 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in at least one public cloud environment (aws, microsoft azure, or google cloud)
* 4+ years of experience building or supporting distributed data or compute workloads using tools such as emr, spark, glue, or databricks
* 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating real-time or streaming data pipelines
* 2+ years of experience working on data observability (e.g., monte carlo, splunk) or data orchestration tools (e.g., airflow, dagster)
* 4+ years of experience working with unstructured or semistructured data using nosql databases (e.g., mongodb, cassandra, dynamodb)
* 4+ years of experience designing and supporting data warehousing solutions (e.g., snowflake, redshift)
* 2+ years of experience working in an agile development environment
* 2+ years of experience developing user-centric reusable data products

title: Senior Engineer - Data
description:
**why join geico?**

at geico, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. we thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

founded in 1936, geico is a member of the berkshire hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the united states. when you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. that's why we offer the geico pledge: great company, great culture, great rewards, and great careers.

**senior engineer - data**

**position summary**

geico is seeking an experienced senior data engineer with a passion for building high-performance, low maintenance, zero-downtime data solutions. you will help drive our insurance business transformation as we transition from a traditional it model to a tech organization with engineering excellence as its mission. within the data analytics and vertical engineering team, you will play a key role in leveraging modern technologies to enhance our data capabilities, while championing innovation, best practices, and continuous learning.

**position description**

as a senior data engineer, you will work to build and maintain robust data systems that power a state-of-the-art analytics platform. our team thrives and succeeds in delivering high-quality data solutions in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. the ideal candidate has broad and deep technical knowledge, typically ranging from data pipeline development and data transformation to data storage and processing optimization.

**position responsibilities**

as a senior engineer, you will:

* scope, design, and build scalable, resilient distributed systems

* utilize programming languages like python, sql, and nosql databases, along with apache spark for data processing, dbt for data transformation, container orchestration services such as docker and kubernetes, and various azure tools and services
* use your technical expertise to shape product definitions and drive towards optimal solutions
* engage in cross-functional collaboration throughout the entire development lifecycle

* lead in design sessions and code reviews with peers to elevate the quality of engineering across the organization
* define, create, and support reusable data components and patterns that align with both business and technology requirements
* build a world-class analytics platform to satisfy reporting needs
* mentor other engineers
* consistently share best practices and improve processes within and across teams

title: Sr. AI Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
why stifel:

stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

let’s talk about how you can find your place here at stifel, **where success meets success**.

what you'll be doing:

the sr. ai cloud platform engineer is a member of the security engineering & automation team, the security organization's shared build capability, and is responsible for the platform architecture and hands-on engineering of secure, reusable capabilities that enable security teams to operate more efficiently and consistently. this role architects and develops shared security platforms, tool integrations, ai-enabled security capabilities, metrics and dashboarding services, proofs of concept, and automation that removes recurring manual work, built once and designed for adoption by multiple security pods rather than as one-off solutions. operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners with security architecture and cloud platform architects to align team-owned solutions with organizational standards and strategic direction. the team operates under a clear contract, security engineering & automation builds, and consuming pods configure, run, and report.

what we're looking for:

* lead the architecture and technical design of the team's shared capabilities — platforms, services, integrations, apis, data pipelines, and automation — built to be secure, scalable, resilient, and reusable.
* build shared security tool integrations and reusable automation that eliminate manual toil, reduce duplicated engineering effort, and improve consistency across security pods.
* architect ai solutions that both secure the organization's use of ai and apply ai to improve security operations, analysis, and decision support.
* build and maintain shared metrics, data, and dashboarding capabilities, including common data models and integration patterns, that enable automated, business-readable reporting across the security organization.
* partner with security architecture to embed security requirements, approved patterns, controls, and risk decisions into platform designs, and collaborate with enterprise and cloud platform architects to align with broader technology strategies and standards.
* translate business, security, operational, and regulatory requirements into platform designs and executable implementation plans.
* develop infrastructure as code using terraform, cloudformation, or cdk, and build automation and integrations using python, bash, powershell, aws lambda, step functions, apis, and event-driven and workflow orchestration services.
* embed identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network controls, data protection, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement into team-owned solutions.
* conduct proofs of concept and technical evaluations to validate solution viability and inform build-versus-buy decisions, assessing technologies for technical fit, security, interoperability, supportability, cost, and reuse potential.
* create reusable reference architectures, implementation patterns, technical standards, and onboarding guidance, and contribute to the team's service catalog, including available capabilities, engagement criteria, and ownership expectations.
* define consumption, configuration, and support boundaries for team-built services in partnership with product management and consuming pods, along with measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, onboarding time, and data freshness.
* maintain the reliability, availability, observability, and security of shared team-owned platforms and their ci/cd and operational tooling, and support incidents and root-cause analysis while pod-specific operations, triage, and tool administration remain with the consuming pod.
* publish architecture diagrams, decision records, runbooks, and service documentation, and communicate evaluations, proof-of-concept results, roadmaps, and delivered business value through planning forums, demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews.
* mentor engineers and promote strong platform engineering, secure development, automation, and architecture practices within the team.

what you'll bring:

* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify manual toil and design reusable capabilities that eliminate it.
* ability to effectively communicate technical topics and architectural decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* deep understanding of platform architecture principles, including scalability, reliability, observability, interoperability, and cost management.
* understanding of ai and llm-based systems, including generative ai, agentic workflows, and their security considerations.
* demonstrated ability to operate independently, lead technical design efforts, prioritize workload, and collaborate across organizational boundaries.
* experience architecting and developing reusable cloud or platform capabilities — integrations, automation, apis, or data pipelines — used by multiple teams.
* experience conducting proofs of concept, technical evaluations, and build-versus-buy assessments.
* experience incorporating security requirements and controls into cloud and platform solutions in partnership with security architecture or comparable governance functions.
* experience designing for measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, reliability, and onboarding efficiency.

education & experience:

* minimum required: bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, computer engineering, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, or related field, or a related combination of education and experience.
* minimum required: 6+ years of platform, infrastructure, devops, cloud, automation, integration, security engineering, or software engineering experience; 3+ years of hands-on aws experience in production environments.
* minimum required: experience applying ai, machine learning, or generative ai to automation, engineering, or security use cases.
* preferred: experience with metrics platforms, apis, or workflow orchestration.
* preferred: experience supporting regulated or financial-services environments.

licenses & credentials:

* minimum required: aws certified solutions architect — associate or professional, or equivalent demonstrated aws expertise.
* preferred: aws certified devops engineer — professional.
* aws certified security — specialty, aws certified machine learning — specialty, hashicorp terraform associate, ccsp, cissp, or comparable cloud, ai, or platform engineering credentials, is a plus.

systems & technology:

* deep hands-on aws experience, including services such as ec2, vpc, iam, lambda, ecs/eks, s3, rds, cloudwatch, organizations, and control tower.
* experience with infrastructure as code (terraform, cloudformation, or cdk) and scripting and automation using python, bash, powershell, or similar languages.
* experience designing and integrating apis, event-driven services, workflow automation, and third-party security technologies for adoption by multiple teams.
* experience with ai and machine learning services such as amazon bedrock, amazon sagemaker, azure openai, or openai apis, including generative ai, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and model gateways.
* working knowledge of cloud and platform security, including iam least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network security, logging, monitoring, data protection, and policy-as-code.
* preferred: metrics, dashboarding, and data platforms such as grafana, power bi, quicksight, or opensearch.
* preferred: ci/cd tooling (github actions, azure devops, or jenkins), container orchestration (docker, kubernetes, or ecs/eks), and observability tooling (datadog, prometheus, or opentelemetry).
* preferred: experience with opa, aws config, service control policies, cloud security posture management, data-loss prevention, or automated guardrail technologies.

nlr is located at the foothills of the rocky mountains in golden, colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

join the national laboratory of the rockies (nlr), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. from our mission to our collaborative culture, nlr stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. our work helps strengthen u.s. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

**job description**
===================

the national laboratory of the rockies’ (nlr) cybersecurity research is strengthening our grid against tomorrow's threats. the selected intern would join the cyber mission assurance team to support research efforts within the cybersecurity research center’s portfolio including:

* characterization of the potential for u.s. electric grid disruption from natural hazards and human threats
* assessment of the cybersecurity of distributed energy systems
strengthening the resilience of the u.s. electric grid

document software designs, experiments, and technical results

title: Data & Integration Engineer
description:
**data & integration engineer**
===============================

**location:** austin, texas

**work arrangement:** full-time, onsite

**about integrated financial settlements**
------------------------------------------

for over 40 years, integrated financial settlements (ifs) has been transforming lives by helping people achieve financial stability after life-altering events or injuries. our innovative products and services provide long-term financial security, spendthrift protection, and peace of mind to vulnerable individuals navigating challenging circumstances. we're building the next generation of financial technology to serve our mission more effectively and at greater scale.

**our vision & values**
-----------------------

as a collaborative community, our passion is to introduce options that restore stability, encourage hope, and create possibilities for people impacted by injury. we help people navigate change by providing effective financial solutions to support their goals. our work is guided by four core values:

* **integrity:** do what is right
* **innovation:** seek opportunities to learn, improve, and encourage creative thought
* **collaboration:** we are better together. diversity of experience and thought enriches our work and lives
* **empathy:** acknowledge others and ask questions. listen to find out what is important

**the opportunity**
-------------------

this is a ground-floor opportunity to architect and build the core data and integration backbone of a growing financial services company. you'll design a greenfield enterprise data architecture, connecting internal platforms, third-party systems, banking partners, and external data sources into a unified operating platform. as one of the foundational members of our technology organization, you'll be responsible for creating the architectural patterns, integration frameworks, data models, and ai-ready infrastructure that power the next phase of our growth. you'll transform a business operating across fragmented systems into one powered by trusted data, automated workflows, intelligent decision-making, and secure financial transactions.

**what makes someone successful in this role**
----------------------------------------------

* you enjoy creating new capabilities from the ground up and are energized by solving complex problems with practical solutions
* you understand how technology enables revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk management, and customer experience
* you seek elegant solutions that reduce complexity and technical debt rather than introducing unnecessary technology
* you operate as if you own the platform and are accountable for its reliability, scalability, and long-term success
* you understand that successful ai initiatives depend on quality data, strong governance, semantic consistency, and effective integration patterns
* you can move between architecture, engineering, solution design, vendor management, troubleshooting, and strategic planning as business needs evolve
* you can operate independently with limited oversight while maintaining alignment with organizational objectives

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

* build and manage our enterprise data architecture, including canonical data models, data domains, governance standards, lineage, master data strategies, and quality controls
* design and implement a semantic layer that powers analytics, reporting, ai applications, and future agentic workflows
* define enterprise integration architecture, api standards, integration patterns, and reusable connectivity frameworks
* build and manage etl/elt pipelines, orchestration frameworks, event-driven processes, observability, monitoring, retry strategies, and operational support
* design secure and compliant data movement across internal, external, and regulated environments
* lead integration efforts with banking and payment systems, including ach, wire processing, payment networks, custodians, and financial infrastructure providers
* develop integration endpoints and services supporting salesforce, workflow platforms, customer applications, and external partners
* create data structures and architectures optimized for ai agents, machine learning models, retrieval systems, and intelligent automation
* establish scalable architectural patterns that support future business capabilities while minimizing technical debt
* partner closely with business and technology teams to translate business processes into scalable technical solutions
* evaluate emerging technologies related to ai, data engineering, integration platforms, and cloud architecture

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, integration engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, or related technical roles
* demonstrated experience building platforms with limited resources and small teams, with a track record of delivering practical solutions that scale as the business grows
* proven experience designing and implementing enterprise data platforms from architecture through production support
* hands-on experience integrating with banking, payment, fintech, or financial services platforms
* strong experience designing apis, integration services, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and distributed systems
* deep understanding of data modeling, canonical data design, master data management, governance, lineage, and data quality practices
* hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms such as snowflake, databricks, bigquery, redshift, or equivalent technologies
* experience building etl/elt solutions using tools such as airflow, matillion, fivetran, azure data factory, or equivalent platforms
* strong sql skills and proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as python, java, or c#
* experience implementing secure data transmission, encryption, authentication, authorization, and audit controls
* experience designing solutions for reliability, observability, scalability, compliance, and operational support
* ability to operate across architecture, engineering, and business discussions without requiring specialized teams for every decision

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* experience building ai-ready data architectures and semantic models
* experience implementing vector databases, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), knowledge graphs, or related ai infrastructure
* experience supporting ai agents, copilots, workflow automation, or agentic architecture
* familiarity with openai, anthropic, azure ai, aws ai services, or other enterprise ai platforms
* experience in integrating structured and unstructured data sources for ai and analytics use cases
* experience with real-time data streaming platforms such as kafka, event hub, kinesis, or pub/sub
* experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, banking, lending, insurance, or payments
* prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth company where individuals were expected to operate across multiple disciplines

**work environment**
--------------------

* full-time, onsite position based in austin, texas
* 40-hour work week with flexibility to work extended hours as needed based on business needs
* regular verbal and written communication with cross-functional teams
* extended periods of sitting at a computer workstation
* dexterity required to operate computer keyboard, mouse, and other computer components
* light physical effort including occasional handling of objects up to 20 pounds and frequent handling of objects up to 10 pounds

**ready to build the future?**
------------------------------

if you're an experienced data and integration engineer excited about architecting enterprise platforms from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you. join our team and help us transform financial services for people who need it most.

**to apply, please submit your resume and a brief note about your experience with enterprise data architecture and integration projects.**

title: AI Automation Intern
description:
high five media is looking for an ai automation intern to build ai tools and automations that help our small business clients save time and grow, with the opportunity to move into a full-time position.

**overview**

this internship provides on-site ai and automation services to deliver cohesive, consistent, quality work to our clients. duties of this position will include building ai chatbots and assistants, workflow automations, ai-powered search over client data, machine learning solutions, and troubleshooting for small businesses. this position requires up to 30 hours per week and the ability to hit the "go live gong" when necessary.

**duties and responsibilities**

* understand the vision of a project for various clients by referencing the client brief
* meet with small business clients to understand how their business runs and find tasks that ai and automation can handle
* choose the right approach for each problem: a fixed workflow, an llm-powered workflow, or an ai agent that decides which tools and actions to use
* build workflow automations in n8n that connect the tools small businesses already use (crms, email, google workspace, google sheets, airtable, slack, forms, scheduling, and payments)
* build ai applications and agents that use tools, apis, and business data
* build rag (retrieval-augmented generation) systems that let clients search and chat with their own documents, websites, and data
* build ai chatbots, assistants, and voice agents for client websites, phone lines, customer support, and lead qualification
* build and apply machine learning models for small business needs, such as lead scoring, forecasting, and classifying customer data
* prove that every ai system works before it reaches a client: build test datasets, set evaluation criteria, measure accuracy and reliability, and find hallucinations
* re-test ai systems whenever prompts, models, or data change
* launch ai tools and automations to production and monitor their performance so they keep working
* keep client data, api keys, and ai systems secure and private
* document every automation and ai tool so clients and coworkers can use and maintain it
* work with the web development team to add ai features to client websites
* estimate how long tasks will take and meet those deadlines
* communicate project details effectively to high five account managers in a timely manner
* provide status reports on ai and automation projects to the project manager

**knowledge, skills, abilities**

***required***

* practical understanding of how large language models work: tokens, context windows, model selection, hallucinations and failure modes, and cost and speed tradeoffs
* experience with major ai models and platforms (openai, anthropic claude, google gemini, and open-source models)
* proficiency in python
* experience with apis, webhooks, and json
* prompt engineering, structured outputs (json schemas), and tool/function calling
* understanding of embeddings, semantic search, and rag
* understanding of when to use a fixed workflow, an llm-powered workflow, or an ai agent
* experience with n8n or a similar workflow automation tool (make, zapier)
* ability to test and evaluate ai systems: test datasets, evaluation criteria, accuracy, and reliability
* understanding of machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, training and evaluating models, and when to use machine learning instead of an llm
* understanding of ai security and data privacy, including protecting api keys and preventing prompt injection
* working knowledge of git

***preferred***

* langchain, langgraph, llamaindex, or the openai/anthropic agent sdks
* vector databases (pinecone, supabase/pgvector, qdrant, or similar)
* understanding of mcp (model context protocol) and how ai systems connect to external tools and data
* experience with the newest ai platforms and agent tools, such as claude (including claude code), openai codex, chatgpt, cursor, and similar
* ai voice agents (vapi, retell, elevenlabs, twilio)
* self-hosting n8n and ai tools (docker, a vps, supabase)
* sql databases
* javascript
* machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, pytorch, or tensorflow
* experience with google sheets, airtable, crms, and small business tools (hubspot, sales for quickbooks, google workspace, or similar)
* experience building older websites (older php, static html, and older wordpress sites)

***all candidates***

* ability to explain ai to non-technical small business owners in plain language
* strong project management skills
* thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple projects and deadlines
* outstanding communication and writing skills
* creative, innovative, self-motivated, and organized
* ability to speak tactfully with clients under occasionally stressful circumstances
* experience with mac os
* must be able to establish and build relationships with coworkers appropriately
* good taste in music and the ability to wield a game controller is also a plus

**education and experience**

currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a program in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, or a related field preferred. if not enrolled in or graduated from a program in the above fields, equivalent experience building ai tools and automations is required. all applicants must provide a portfolio of at least 2–3 projects showing that they can connect ai to real-world data, tools, or workflows, with links to live demos, screenshots, or videos, and a link to their code (github or similar). examples include:

* an ai chatbot connected to a knowledge base
* an n8n automation using an llm and apis
* a rag application
* an ai lead qualification system
* a document-processing pipeline
* an ai agent that uses tools
* a small machine learning prediction or classification project

**company general policy & procedure**

high five media maintains normal working hours of monday through friday, 8:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. should an employee have any questions or need to make changes to their regular work schedule, the employee should contact their supervisor. high five media requests that all work be done in the high five media office. only on rare occasions, with supervisor/partner approval, will an employee be able to work outside the office. the requirements listed above are representative of the job duties. employees must be able to demonstrate the knowledge and ability to perform their job duties satisfactorily and will be subject to regular employee evaluations. the information listed in this position description reflects an overall review of the duties considered essential to this position. the information listed should not be considered a full and complete description of all work requirements that may be involved in the position.

**physical demands**

the following physical demands are representative of activities that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential tasks of this position. reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential tasks of this position. while performing the duties of this position, the employee will be regularly required to use their hands to type, handle small job-related equipment, and use the telephone. the employee will occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move up to 20 pounds.

**compensation**

commensurate with experience

**job type:** internship

**schedule:**

* monday to friday

**experience:**

* ai / automation development: 1 year (preferred)

pay: $15.00 - $20.00 per hour

expected hours: 30.0 per week

title: Sr. Data Reliability Engineer I
description:
**who we are**
==============

title: Software Engineer, Advanced Analytics
description:
**job description**

  

**at general motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. we’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.**

**every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.**

gm's advanced analytics team turns the engineering organization's data into decisions, then builds the software that puts those decisions in front of the people making them.
  
we do the analytics and data science: forecasting and statistical analysis of program execution, the kpis engineering leadership runs the business on, curated databricks data products across parts, bills of material, engineering changes, warranty, and resource demand, and a growing amount of ai tooling. our partners span vehicle hardware engineering, software and electronics, supplier quality, warranty, and program management.

**the role**

this role serves as the second software engineer on a rapidly growing portfolio, supporting end‑to‑end feature development. work often begins with understanding how vehicle program stakeholders operate and extends through designing schemas, building apis, developing interfaces, wiring data pipelines, and monitoring service‑level objectives after deployment.

weekly work may span tuning postgres query plans, building and refining react components, writing databricks jobs, and adjusting kubernetes manifests. as the software engineer embedded within a team of data scientists, the position is responsible for defining and executing how software solutions are built **.**

**what you'll do (responsibilities)**

* contribute as part of a cross‑functional team to propose and implement high‑impact, data‑driven software and analytic solutions for engineering organizations.
* build and deliver end‑to‑end features, including python services, relational data models, and typescript/react interfaces.
* develop and maintain data pipelines that integrate gm’s engineering systems of record into applications and data products.
* collaborate with data scientists to operationalize analytical work and deliver it to end users through scalable products.
* deploy and operate production systems using kubernetes on azure, ci/cd workflows, infrastructure as code, and modern observability practices.
* partner with stakeholders across vehicle hardware, software, electronics, supplier quality, and program management to translate workflows into adoptable software solutions.
* ensure interfaces are intuitive and user‑friendly, with attention to daily usability and feedback from engineering teams.
participate in and lead code reviews, testing efforts, and documentation to maintain high engineering standards.  

**your skills & abilities (required qualifications)**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of experience building and shipping production software
* proficiency in python and typescript/javascript, including experience with modern component‑based web frameworks such as react.
* working knowledge of sql and relational data modeling.
* experience guiding a feature from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, testing, code review, and production deployment.
ability to work directly with non‑engineering stakeholders and translate their needs into clear technical decisions.  

**what will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications)**

* 3+ years of experience writing production-quality software

* experience with fastapi or other asynchronous python web frameworks, and familiarity with sqlalchemy.
* background in next.js, react server components, or comparable modern full‑stack react frameworks.
* depth in postgresql, including schema design, query optimization, and migration management.
* experience with databricks, pyspark, delta lake, or similar large‑scale data processing technologies.
* experience deploying to kubernetes on a major cloud platform—ideally azure—using gitops and infrastructure‑as‑code practices.
* strong attention to user experience and design systems.
* experience integrating enterprise systems of record and building reliable data products on top of them.
* prior work as the software engineer on a data‑ or analytics‑heavy team.
* familiarity with automotive or manufacturing product development processes, such as vehicle program timing, plm, or bill‑of‑material data.
experience as an early engineer on a product, contributing to foundational patterns and technical direction.

title: Data Engineer
description:
the data engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable data pipelines for network distribution’s enterprise data and ai platforms. this role will ingest, transform, and validate data from operational systems into reliable, business-ready datasets that support reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and machine learning initiatives. the data engineer will collaborate with it, bi developers, business stakeholders, and project teams, the data engineer develops reusable pipelines and data models while ensuring data quality, security, and performance. success requires strong sql and python skills, experience with cloud data platforms, an understanding of modern data engineering and machine learning concepts, and a basic understanding of supply chain data such as orders, inventory, logistics, and financial reporting are essential.

***what you'll do:***

* design, develop, and maintain data pipelines that ingest data from operational systems into the enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and ai/ml environments.
* develop data transformation and loading processes using sql, python, and modern data engineering tools.
* integrate data from erp platforms, saas applications, apis, cloud storage, and other enterprise systems.
* develop and support ingestion processes using cloud services, apis, file-based integrations, and data integration platforms.
* develop and perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
* identify data anomalies and assist with root-cause analysis and remediation.
* support the preparation, transformation, and delivery of data used by machine learning and ai solutions.
* collaborate with ai/ml engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements for model development and production workloads.
* support and maintain cloud data warehouse and data lake environments.
* support platform monitoring, automation, performance optimization, and production stability.
* document pipeline processes, data flows, architecture, integration patterns, dependencies, and support procedures

***who you are:***

* demonstrates innovation, flexibility, and self-direction, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, collaboration with cross-functional team
* proven ability to cultivate a team-oriented environment, mentor, and engage with senior business stakeholders in business-centric dialogue.
* skilled in documentation for requirements, design, test, and training.
* experience in designing and implementing scalable data models and architecture.
* strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* data validation & quality assurance
* analytical thinking & troubleshooting
* technical documentation
* strong sql development, query optimization, data transformation, and etl/elt pipeline development experience.
* experience with snowflake, including data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, and cloud-based data processing.
* experience with cloud platforms and services such as aws.
* python development and scripting experience.
* experience with apis, data ingestion, integration technologies, and structured and semi-structured data, including json and xml.
* understanding of data warehouse architecture, data modeling, data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* working knowledge of machine learning concepts and experience preparing and transforming data to support ml models and ai/ml workloads.
* familiarity with aws services such as s3, glue, lambda, step functions, and sagemaker or similar cloud technologies.
* experience with sap or other enterprise erp data is preferred.
* familiarity with dbt, terraform, ci/cd, git, java, or similar development and deployment technologies.
* exposure to generative ai, large language models (llms), and enterprise ai platforms is a plus.

***what you'll have:***

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* minimum of five (5) years of experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or software development involving significant data responsibilities
* strong understanding of data architecture, enterprise systems, and business process automation.
* strong understanding of data governance frameworks.
* knowledge of information security principles and data protection best practices.
* demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives while managing operational responsibilities.
* understanding of data processing concepts (etl/elt).
* understanding of data warehouse architecture and data modeling concepts.

* medical, dental, & vision coverage
* generous pto policy

* learning & development opportunities
* progressive wellness program
* 401k matching program
* generous profit sharing contribution
* fun work environment with many company sponsored events

* experience developing cloud-native solutions on azure, aws, or google cloud platform, including apis, microservices, ci/cd pipelines, docker, and kubernetes.

description:
**why join geico?**

at geico, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. we thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

founded in 1936, geico is a member of the berkshire hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the united states. when you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. that's why we offer the geico pledge: great company, great culture, great rewards, and great careers.

**position description**

our senior engineer works with our engineering team to innovate and build new systems, improve and enhance existing systems, and identify new opportunities to apply your knowledge to solve critical problems. you will lead the strategy and execution of a technical roadmap that will increase the velocity of delivering products and unlock new engineering capabilities, including shaping how applied ai and intelligent automation are incorporated into enterprise solutions where they materially improve business outcomes. the ideal candidate is a self-starter with deep technical expertise in their domain and a strong sense of which ai technologies are appropriate for various use cases, while ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards for reliability, security, and operability.

**position responsibilities**

as a senior engineer, you will:

* provide technical leadership to multiple areas and provide technical and thought leadership to the enterprise, including applied ai architecture, technology selection, and integration patterns across teams

* collaborate across team members and across the tech organization to solve our toughest problems, working with product, domain experts, and analytics partners to translate business needs into technical designs that may include ai components

* deliver high-quality services and software for a variety of domains, including ai-augmented workflows and intelligent services where appropriate, with accountability for the quality, usability, and performance of the solutions

* identify and evaluate opportunities to apply ai, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows to enterprise processes, distinguishing high-value use cases from hype-driven experiments

* utilize programming languages like java, c#, or other object-oriented languages, sql, and nosql databases, container orchestration services including docker and kubernetes, cloud tools and services across azure/aws/gcp, and integrate ai services, model apis, and orchestration tooling into the platform stack

* work on end-to-end solutions that may span front-end implementations (flutter, angular, react) through api tiers and back-end domain services

* be a role model and mentor, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know-how of our engineering and product community, including applied ai patterns, production evaluation, and responsible deployment practices. influence and educate executives

* design durable, observable ai workflows using orchestration and agent patterns (e.g., temporal for long-running workflows; fable and comparable agent frameworks), combining tools, apis, business rules, and human-in-the-loop steps

* select and rationalize ai technologies for each use case—models, retrieval, vector stores, knowledge graphs, workflow engines—with clear tradeoffs on cost, latency, accuracy, security, and operability

* establish engineering patterns for evaluating, monitoring, and governing components in production, including testing, quality metrics, safety, fallback behavior, and incident response

**qualifications**

* exemplary ability to design, perform experiments—including ai/llm evaluation, measurement, and iterative improvement in production—and influence engineering direction and product roadmap

* extensive experience shipping llm, generative ai, or intelligent automation solutions in production environments

* strong grasp of when to use agents, retrieval-augmented generation, classical ml, rules-based workflows, or hybrid approaches for a given business problem

* experience integrating ai into enterprise services via apis, events, authentication, and observability patterns

* understanding of agent architectures, workflow orchestration, vector retrieval, and knowledge/context design

* extensive experience in leading and building full-stack application and service development, with a strong focus on saas products / platforms

* proven expertise in designing and developing microservices using graphql, grpc, java, python, kafka, with a deep understanding of both api and event-driven architectures, including integration of ai inference, retrieval, and async/agent workflows

* proven experience designing and delivering highly-resilient event-driven and messaging-based solutions at scale with minimal latency, including long-running, failure-tolerant workflows for multi-step ai processes

* fluency and specialization with at least two modern oop languages such as java, c#, c++, or python including object-oriented design

* great understanding of open-source databases like mysql, postgresql, etc., and a strong foundation with nosql databases like cosmos, cassandra, apache trino, etc.

* knowledge of developer tooling across the software development life cycle (task management, source code, building, deployment, operations, real-time communication)

* fluency in test engineering and automated testing concepts, including evaluation and regression testing for non-deterministic ai components

**experience**

6+ years full-stack development experience (java/c#/python/go), with expertise in client-side and server-side frameworks

4+ years of experience with architecture and design

2+ years of applied ai, generative ai, or intelligent automation experience in production, or demonstrable ownership of ai-enabled platform capabilities

2+ years of experience with aws, gcp, azure, or another cloud service

bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent education or work experience
